limits: Whole muscles are not counted as separately named tendons. Four named checklist families are represented by genuine labeled subdivisions; this distinction is recorded in matchType.

Five attachment-context cases (four meniscal horns plus articularis genus) are not counted as exact whole-structure matches. Lumbar/sacral plexuses, tarsal tunnel and femoral triangle are regional/network context, not fabricated discrete callouts.
The talus-specific flexor-hallucis-longus groove remains unmatched: the generic 79.14 groove label is not bone-specific and its leader is compatible with the calcaneal/sustentacular channel.
Medial calcaneal branches do not count as lateral calcaneal branches or the inferior calcaneal/Baxter nerve. Those exact targets remain open.
Metatarsophalangeal plantar ligaments are not silently counted as an explicitly labeled plantar plate; interphalangeal collaterals are not matched to metatarsophalangeal collateral labels.
No-exact-gallery-target means no exact interactive source target in the active gallery data, not absence from the underlying textbook or broad illustration.
Question validation counts candidates using the current builder policy. Any studyOnly metadata is listed separately so the integration lane can reconcile study-versus-graded intent.
